question: Who won the Miss World 2025 title?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Opal Suchata Chuangsri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Thailand’s Opal Suchata Wins 72nd Miss World Title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Miss Thailand Opal Suchata Chuangsri** was **crowned Miss World 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The **72nd Miss World Pageant** was held in **Hyderabad, India**.

 
 
• 
 
She was crowned by **Miss World 2024 Krystyna Pyszková**.

 
 
• 
 
This is **Thailand’s first-ever win** at the Miss World pageant.

 
 
• 
 
The **Runner-up** title went to **Hasset of Ethiopia**.

 
 
• 
 
**India** has won the Miss World title **6 times**.

 
 
• 
 
The last Indian winner was **Manushi Chhillar in 2017**.
